# Security policy

## Supported work

This project is at the planning stage. Once implementation begins, security fixes will target the active `main` branch. No production release or response-time guarantee is offered.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MelvinShingiro/rentwise/security/advisories/new) for security findings. Include the affected component, reproduction steps, and potential impact. Do not include secrets, customer data, or exploit details in public issues.
